    MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.StarTrace.connected_cokerSpan_wt

    The spanning row of a connected periodic quiver winds once #

    Strengthening of connected_cokerSpan for Proposition 7.5: the spanning row (if any) of a finite connected stable translation quiver in characteristic two has a winding mesh weight in which the weight of the row minus ν of its vertex is one (connected_cokerSpan_wt; the weight is floorWt).

    ∃ (S : ScalarMeshCategory.RowSet Q), Set.Subsingleton S ∧ ScalarMeshCategory.CokerSpan c S ∧ ∀ R ∈ S, ∃ (W : MeshWalk.MeshWt Q ℤ), W.pw R.snd - W.ν R.fst = 1
